541105ca16c0a576f611d56da47c9ac7.overview: A group of academics have spent years shut up in a house working on the definitive encyclopedia. When one of them discovers that his entry on slang is hopelessly outdated, he ventures into the wide world to learn about the evolving language. Here he meets Sugarpuss O’Shea, a nightclub singer, who’s on top of all the slang—and, it just so happens, needs a place to stay.
541105ca16c0a576f611d56da47c9ac7.tagline: “I LOVE HIM because he doesn't know how to kiss—THE JERK!”

541f8e05e6eccdd82e054dee10b057ad.overview: While holding a séance for skeptical novelist Charles Condomine, self-proclaimed 'spiritualist medium' Madame Arcati inadvertently summons the spirit of his deceased first wife Elvira, leading to an increasingly complex love triangle with Ruth, his current wife of five years.
541f8e05e6eccdd82e054dee10b057ad.tagline: Elvira is the kind of gal who can turn an evening into a night you'll never forget!

542a2ad1fc4f9031d5d604da72845ba2.overview: The relationship between Lelia, a light-skinned black woman, and Tony, a white man is put in jeopardy when Tony meets Lelia’s darker-skinned jazz singer brother, Hugh, and discovers that her racial heritage is not what he thought it was.
542a2ad1fc4f9031d5d604da72845ba2.tagline: A film not to be missed.

542cc9fc5a9d7819e9fc5701fb547ac8.overview: Self-important author Leon joins his best friend on a summer holiday near the Baltic Sea to complete his novel. When they arrive, they find their house is already occupied by a carefree woman who challenges Leon to open up. Meanwhile, forest wildfires rage around them and impending disaster looms.

54507c9dd9cc99bc338af2cf76ab1c92.overview: Intrepid young reporter, Tintin, and his loyal dog, Snowy, are thrust into a world of high adventure when they discover a ship carrying an explosive secret. As Tintin is drawn into a centuries-old mystery, Ivan Ivanovitch Sakharine suspects him of stealing a priceless treasure. Tintin and Snowy, with the help of salty, cantankerous Captain Haddock and bumbling detectives, Thompson and Thomson, travel half the world, one step ahead of their enemies, as Tintin endeavors to find the Unicorn, a sunken ship that may hold a vast fortune, but also an ancient curse.
54507c9dd9cc99bc338af2cf76ab1c92.tagline: Discover how far adventure will take you.

547b2e970fa6520ef83f893452f62e18.overview: Clarice Starling is a top student at the FBI's training academy.  Jack Crawford wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath, serving life behind bars for various acts of murder and cannibalism.  Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out.
547b2e970fa6520ef83f893452f62e18.tagline: To enter the mind of a killer she must challenge the mind of a madman.

54a1f9d7657cabc5a0fc0c3330d25ba9.overview: After a single, career-minded woman is left on her own to give birth to the child of a married man, she finds a new romantic chance in a cab driver. Meanwhile, the point-of-view of the newborn baby is narrated through voice-over.
54a1f9d7657cabc5a0fc0c3330d25ba9.tagline: He's hip, he's cool, and he's only 3 months old.

54b99cedcf861c9935bc8e29ea94be6a.overview: After his young lover, Gitone, leaves him for another man, Encolpio decides to kill himself, but a sudden earthquake destroys his home before he has a chance to do so. Now wandering around Rome in the time of Nero, Encolpio encounters one bizarre and surreal scene after another.

54d7d43d619610a6140537e1c7f75870.overview: An Italian socialite on the run signs on as housekeeper for a widower with three children.
54d7d43d619610a6140537e1c7f75870.tagline: It All Happens Happily on a Heaven of a Houseboat!
